column4: Prevention of Offences relating to Sports
(1) There shall be established a Reward Fund under

column3: the control and administration of the Secretary for the purpose
of rewarding persons who provide information that results
in  the  detection  of  any  offence  committed  by  any  person
under  this  Act  and  the  prosecution  of  such  offence.  The
members of the Unit shall not be entitled to any reward from
the Reward Fund.

column4: There shall be paid into the Reward Fund all such

column3: sums of money as may be voted upon from time to time by
Parliament for the purpose.

column4: The Minister may prescribe the manner in which

column3: rewards shall be paid to persons who provide information.
The amount of reward shall be determined on the basis of
detection,  institution  of  proceedings  and  successful
prosecution, of an offence.

column4: The Secretary shall cause proper books of accounts

column3: to  be  kept  of  the  income  and  expenditure  of  the  Reward
Fund and all other financial transactions in relation to the
Reward Fund.

column4: The provisions of Article 154 of the Constitution

column3: shall apply to, and in relation to, the audit of the accounts of
the Reward Fund.

column4: No member of the Unit or any officer, employee or

column3: other person   appointed to assist the Unit for the purposes of
this Act, shall be liable in any suit or other legal proceedings
for any lawful act which is done or purported to be done in
good faith by such member, officer, employee or person as
the case may be, in pursuance of the powers conferred by or
under this Act, or for the purpose of carrying out the provisions
of this Act.
